requirements: R1: Patch existing task synchronization logic to accurately reflect actual GitHub PR states in internal records.

slices.title: Patch task sync to actual GitHub PR state
slices.jtbd: When implementing the CI status reconciliation patch for this epic, I want to fetch and align actual GitHub PR states with internal task records, so that operational reality is accurate.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task internally marked 'done' with conflicting GitHub PR state, When the synchronization patch runs, Then the internal status is updated to exactly match the PR state.
Given a fresh install with test task records, When the synchronization logic is executed, Then automated unit and integration tests must pass proving desynchronization is resolved.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of desynchronized task records from the baseline of 3 known discrepancy nodes to 0.
